summary.text: Bobby Wilson is the Libertarian Party nominee for Arkansas's 3rd Congressional District. He previously ran for this seat in 2024, losing to Steve Womack, and manages a trim company in Northwest Arkansas. Public information about his background is limited.

paragraphs.text: Wilson was born in Greenville, North Carolina, and has a career background in management; his campaign website says he manages a trim company in Northwest Arkansas that supplies home builders.

He ran for Arkansas's 3rd District in 2024 as the Libertarian candidate and lost to Womack in the general election. He advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on February 22, 2026, as the party's 2026 nominee.
